difficulty_reason: Prove that D_1 subset D_2 with degrees d_1, d_2 yields D of degree d_2 - d_1 with D_2 = D_1 + D: both are relative effective Cartier divisors (lemma-divisors-on-curves); divisors-lemma-difference-relative-effective-Cartier-divisor produces the relative effective Cartier D with D_2 = D_1 + D; D -> S is locally quasi-finite, flat, lfp by lemma-divisors-on-curves and finite as a closed subscheme of D_2, hence finite locally free (morphisms-lemma-finite-flat); the degree d_2 - d_1 follows from lemma-sum-divisors-on-curves.
